M6-T3.notes: DONE 2026-10-06: M6-T3 - PRD 6.1 'autosave of the selected spec + seed to localStorage; shareable URL encodes spec + seed'. src/share/ (7 modules + barrel, 57 tests): (1) codec.ts - ShareState {spec, seed, wearDensity} <-> query string. PRESET-AWARE and compact: a canonical ship is `p=<preset>` (the spec is already in the bundle; `p=patrol` is the whole default link), a custom hull is `s=<base64url JSON>` (UTF-8 via TextEncoder/TextDecoder - em-dash deck labels survive, which btoa alone rejects). seed rides only when it differs from the spec's own; `w` only when not 'full'. The decoder is TOTAL and STRICT: unknown preset / malformed base64 / non-spec JSON / a spec isValidShipSpec rejects (so the deliberately-invalid stress rig can NEVER travel in a link) / seed outside 0..2^32-1 / unknown wear rung -> null, never a throw. A `v` wire-version is honoured (absent = current 1). (2) storage.ts - the autosave IS the same query string, under versioned key torchship.share.v1, so a link and an autosave share ONE format (no forked serialization). save/load/clear never throw (denied storage / quota -> false/null), because persistence is a convenience, not a boot requirement. (3) url.ts - shareUrlFor(state, origin+path); syncShareUrl uses history.replaceState (a preset/seed change is not navigation - no back-button spam) and no-ops when the query already matches. (4) resolve.ts - boot PRECEDENCE: explicit share link (URL) -> localStorage autosave -> default preset (Patrol, the 6.1 default). A link that carries share params but fails to decode is treated as ABSENT, so a corrupt link degrades to the autosave rather than blocking the app. effectiveSpec = { ...spec, seed } (the seed control is authoritative; a fresh object so no fixture is mutated); applyShareState persists + publishes in one call. (5) ShareControl.tsx - the DOM affordance (top-right, above the pointer-lock prompt, clear of the M5-T1 overlay): the three real presets (active matched STRUCTURALLY via specsEqual, so the highlight is derived, not a drifting flag), a seed stepper (clamped via the codec's clampSeed), the read-only share link, and a copy button (navigator.clipboard, falling back to selecting the link).
